dataset.title: Data from USDA ARS High Plains Grasslands Research Station (East Unit) near Cheyenne, WY: Yearling cattle weight gains managed in light, moderate and heavily stocked pastures (1982-2022)

adgKgPerAnimalDay.calculation: published gain kg / published days; recomputed here for display/audit only

weightGainConsistency.note: Source weights have more decimal places than rounded gain; do not treat 0.1 kg differences as unexplained model error.

sourceLimitations: USDA catalog says weight-gain outliers beyond ±2 SD of the treatment mean were removed before publication.
No grazing was conducted in 1989, 2000, or 2002 because of drought, according to catalog metadata.
The Tag field is empty in many rows and no pasture/plot identifier is included in the CSV; row-level independent-animal or pasture splits cannot be reconstructed for the full dataset.
The dataset provides entry/exit weight and stocking rate but no individual DMI, forage biomass, current feed cost, or confinement comparator.
This report describes a dataset; it does not estimate a causal stocking-rate effect or validate engine.js.
